افتحلتا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَحَلَتَا (iftaḥalatā) /if.ta.ħa.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اُفْتُحِلَتَا (uftuḥilatā) /uf.tu.ħi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
